text: OK, cadet. We sail this afternoon, so we secure the deck for sea.
I'm lashing these drums. When the ship rolls, nothing moves. But first, your PPE. Here, take these gloves.
Thanks. Can I help? I can finish the chipping here, with the hammer.
Stop! Where are your safety glasses?
On your helmet they don't protect your eyes. Put them on. And your ear defenders. Chipping is very loud.
OK. Glasses on, ear defenders on.
Good. Now help me with the lashing. Can you pass me the spanner, please?
Thanks. Not too tight… Good. Tomorrow we paint the mast. You come with me. For that you need a harness.
Yes. A work permit from the Chief Officer. No permit, no work.
No permit, no work. Got it.
Hey Diego, what are you doing?
Come on, we go up the mast now.
Your permit number is four one two.
